messages:
hazel: Need a compact policy for pin tiers + graceful-degrade semantics for catalog launch. Sales wants clear customer options.
omar: Proposal: three pin tiers: Bronze (pay-as-you-go, 30d TTL), Silver (90d included fallback), Gold (180d + agreed reserve capacity). Each tier has explicit fallback behavior.
sophia: For graceful degrade: if KV incompatibilities occur, fallback should either: (a) serve older pin with token inflation warning, or (b) route to lightweight shim with degraded features. Contract must disclose possible token expansion.
roberto: Add per-customer eval escrow: customers can upload a 2k prompt slice; we run a private seeded benchmark and sign result into escrow so migration credits are calculable. Legal?
legal: Escrow OK with NDA clause. Need explicit customer consent text and data retention TTL.
oncall-bot: preflight scheduled: will post perf+quality snapshot when done. :robot_face:
oncall-bot: preflight done: p50 130ms, p95 470ms, quality delta -0.6%. No safety flags. Link: https://ci.internal/preflight/3846200001
hazel: Those look good. Next steps: draft one-pager for Sales with tier table, fallback examples, escrow opt-in, and deprecation notice cadence (default 120d). Omar/Sophia to own text; Roberto to include escrow flow; Legal to approve wording.
omar: I'll draft tier table + routing examples.
sophia: I'll write graceful-degrade scenarios and recommended customer messaging.
roberto: I'll document escrow flow and migration-credit formula.
legal: Will review tomorrow AM.
hazel: Goal: Sales-ready doc by 10am PT tomorrow.
